convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorTrend_CF custom indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for trade execution logic, requiring custom indicator replication and library logic understanding for conversion.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for valid calculation

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: buy signal closes short (if SellPosClose=true), sell signal closes long (if BuyPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM value = fixed lot size (abs value), positive MM value = deposit fraction for risk-based sizing

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses previous bar (index SignalBar+1) crossover confirmation with current bar (index SignalBar) state check: UpValue[1]>DnValue[1] AND UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0] for long (crossover happened on previous bar, still confirmed on signal bar). TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles actual order placement including signal time dedup via UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime. Recount flag forces re-read on CopyBuffer failure. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean gates controlling permission to open/close positions independently.
python_conversion_notes: 1) ColorTrend_CF custom indicator logic must be replicated in Python - reverse-engineer from the .mq5 indicator source if available. 2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh contains BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose - need to extract the exact order placement, position checking, signal-time dedup, and lot calculation logic. 3) The conditional MM sizing (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) is handled inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh - must be reimplemented. 4) SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) - no digit adjustment in the EA itself but verify TradeAlgorithms.mqh doesn't adjust. 5) New bar detection via CIsNewBar class must be replicated. 6) Signal uses 2-bar lookback: bar[SignalBar+1] for crossover detection, bar[SignalBar] for confirmation state.
